De Minaur Upsets Zverev in Vienna Open Semi-Final to Reach Showdown with Alcaraz

01 Nov 2026, 06:04 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysAlex de Minaur advanced to the Vienna Open final following a hard-fought three-set victory over Alexander Zverev, securing a 6-4, 1-6, 7-6 (7-4) win at the Wiener Stadthalle. De Minaur Secures Landmark Semi-Final Victory

Alex de Minaur advanced to the Vienna Open final following a hard-fought three-set victory over Alexander Zverev, securing a 6-4, 1-6, 7-6 (7-4) win at the Wiener Stadthalle. According to the match report, the world No. 10 delivered an aggressive performance to overcome the incoming world No. 1 in a deciding tiebreaker.

The triumph marks De Minaur's first individual tournament win against Zverev, having previously only secured victories over the German in team events and the Laver Cup. The win carries significant implications for the Australian's qualification standing for the end-of-season ATP Finals.

Match Breakdown and Key Moments

  • First Set: De Minaur established early control with aggressive shot-making, hitting 25 winners overall.
  • Second Set: Zverev capitalized on a temporary dip in De Minaur's serving performance to level the match.
  • Decider: De Minaur regrouped in the third set, maintaining his composure through a tense tiebreak despite committing a couple of double faults.

The encounter also featured a dispute involving umpire Arnaud Gabas, who initially issued Zverev a time violation for prolonged ball-bouncing before rescinding the penalty following protests from the German player.

Upcoming Final and Season Implications

With the semi-final win, De Minaur secured a place in the championship match against Carlos Alcaraz, who defeated Daniil Medvedev 6-4, 7-6 (7-2) in the earlier semi-final.

  • Head-to-Head: De Minaur faces a challenging record against Alcaraz, having lost all six of their previous encounters, including a meeting earlier this year at the Australian Open.
  • Race to Turin: Saturday's victory boosted De Minaur's position within the top-eight qualifying spots for the ATP Finals ahead of the final qualifying event at the Paris Masters.

Fans and analysts can verify the official tournament results, match statistics, and upcoming order of play directly through the ATP Tour's official website or the Vienna Open tournament portal.
